sn17.13-20:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Idhāham bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalam evam cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi || na cāyam āyasmā || () Suvaṇṇanikkhassa pi hetu || tīṇi pe || () Suvaṇṇanikkhasatassa pi hetu || cattāri pe || () Siṅginikkhassa pi hetu || pañca || pe|| () Siṅginikkhasatassa pi hetu || cha || () Pathaviyā pi jātarūpaparipurāya hetu || satta || () Āmisa kiñcikkha hetu pi || aṭṭha || () Jīvita hetu pi || () Janapadakalyāṇiyā pi hetu bhaseyyāti sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti || || Tam enam passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantam || || Evam dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dutiyo vaggo || ||
sn17.13-20:2.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Dve Pāti dve Suvaṇṇā ca || Siṅgīhi apare duve || Pathavī Kiñcikkha Jīvitaṃ || Janapadakalyāṇiyā dasā ti || ||
